verdict.rationale: An agent can write the change because configuration is human-readable code ([terraform-docs-1]), and the official MCP server gives AI models current provider docs and modules for more accurate config generation ([terraform-docs-23], [terraform-docs-40]). The agent can then run `terraform plan -out=FILE` and render the diff with `terraform show` or `show -json`, and `-json` streams machine-readable messages for plan/apply ([terraform-docs-30], [terraform-docs-39], [terraform-docs-22]). Apply prompts for approval unless `-auto-approve` is set, and the community credits execution plans as the safe preview step ([terraform-docs-25], [terraform-docs-3], [terraform-comm-15]). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive plan execution (e.g. disabling input prompts), and any first-party or hands-on evidence of an end-to-end agent-authored plan-and-approve workflow (the MCP server covers docs and registry access, not running plans).
